specFirst: Written BEFORE the code, per skills/agentsBestPractices.md §1. This file, spec.md and the per-step CHANGELOG.md are the design record — there is no other document to look for. The decisions were closed with the product owner on 2026-08-19 and are restated in decisions[] below; when behaviour must change, change this file first, then the code.
description: EXPERIMENTAL PROBE (the pilot that closes the molecule-catalog analysis, §11). Given a page/system definition in prose, it walks the three-level molecule catalog and answers which GROUP and which MOLECULE serve each region of the page. It measures the catalog, not the page: it writes no molecule, no usage contract, no page — only measurement artifacts in l4. After the pilot it either becomes the real consumer (the page12 foreseen in agentChangeFrontend) or is absorbed by it.
principles: REUSE THE PLUMBING. Intents, l4 artifacts, stor mechanics and the strict tool wrapper come from agentNewMolecule2/helpers (nmFs, nmSteps) and shared/llmTool, never reimplemented. The catalog is read with the gesture of agentImproveMolecule2's readGroupSkill: await import(reference) and take the exported string.

ONE CATALOG LEVEL PER PROMPT. c1 sees level 1 (the groups) and c2 sees level 2 of ONE group. Never both, never two groups in the same call — the precedent is the 58 KB prompt that brought down i3-edit (analise-skill-molecules.md §2).

THE CATALOG IS THE ONLY SOURCE OF TAGS. Never a usage contract example (measured on 2026-08-19: 38 of their 40 example tags do not exist, across 29 of 31 groups), never the model's memory. A tag outside the group's published list is refused by a deterministic gate.

HONESTY IS AN ANSWER, NOT A FAILURE. A region no published group covers gets group: null; a region no molecule of the chosen group serves gets tag: null. Both need a reason. Inventing a plausible neighbour is the failure mode being measured.

THE REPORT IS MECHANICAL. c3 spends no LLM call: it aggregates what the two steps measured and renders it. A summary written by a model would be a fourth call polluting the token measurement, and it could describe a metric nobody took.

decisions.battery: Runs in the Studio, by hand: one mention per case of the 10-case battery in todo-implementar-agentChooseMolecules.md §3, plus 3 repetitions of cases #4 and #5 (the combobox × autocomplete tie).
decisions.modelType: reasoning + x-tool-strict on both LLM steps, per skills/modelTypes.md ('planning, comparing alternatives, multi-step decisions') and the family precedent (i2-triage, n2-plan). No reasoningEffort: c2 is a fan-out of small items. classifier stays as a second-round experiment.
decisions.fanOut: One c2 step per chosen group, planted in a second phase by the root, because the number of groups is unknown until c1 answers.
decisions.tagSpelling: The FULL prefixed tag ('groupselectone--ml-card-selector') is required. The gate refuses a bare short name instead of completing it: copying the tag exactly is part of what the pilot measures.
decisions.scoring: Manual. The agent never sees the battery's expected answers — a probe that knew them would be measuring itself. The scoring input is run.json.
decisions.tokens: There is no token telemetry on this platform: nothing in the step contract carries provider usage. So 'tokens per step' is measured as the ASSEMBLED PROMPT — chars, with tokens estimated at 4 chars/token, and the catalog block measured apart from the instructions and the input. Approved on 2026-08-19 as the reading of the §11.4 criterion.

conventions.input: Prose from the mention: '@@agentChooseMolecules <definition of the page or system>'. Never an object literal — mls.common.safeParseArgs throws on anything that is not one.
conventions.catalogProject: The catalog is read from the ACTIVE project (mls.actualProject), never from a hardcoded 102040: level 1 at l2/molecules/skill.ts, and every level 2 at the path level 1 publishes in groups[].indexDefs. The agent therefore reads whichever project it is run in, and the pilot's mls-102040-temp needs no special case.
conventions.catalogRead: A LADDER, measured on the first Studio run of 2026-08-19: (1) await import(reference), which is served from the PUBLISHED project and is the only rung a consumer outside the editor has; (2) the same file compiled into the browser cache (compileAndPostProcess with saveCache, then mls.stor.cache.AddMfileIfNeed) and imported from there, for a catalog that exists in the editor and was never published; (3) a readable failure naming the fix. Which rung answered is recorded per level in the artifacts and surfaced in run.json, because a catalog nobody published is unreadable by design and that is a finding about the three-level design, not an incident.
conventions.writesNothing: No source artifact is written or edited. Not the molecule, not the usage.ts/creation.ts (manual by decision of 2026-08-17), not the group index, not the page. Only l4 measurement artifacts.
conventions.regionJoin: The region NAME is the join key between the two steps: c1 names the regions, c2 echoes them verbatim. A choice for an unknown region is a gate failure, because it cannot be joined.
conventions.retry: One retry with the gate errors in the prompt (CH_MAX_ATTEMPTS = 2). A c2 that still fails records ok: false and COMPLETES — the run's product is the measurement, and 'the model insisted on an invented tag' is a result, not a crash.

treeOverview: c0-classify (the root's own call: slug, language, titles)
c1-groups            level 1 -> regions and their groups
c1r-fanout           the root again: plants one c2 per chosen group, plus c3
c2-<group>         level 2 of that group -> the molecule per region
c3-report            mechanical: run.json + the readable summary

steps.agentName: agentChooseMolecules (the root itself — no separate step agent)
steps.goal: Cheap classifier over the prose: is this a definition of a page or system? Propose the runKey slug, detect userLanguage and localize the step titles. It must NOT name a group, a molecule or a tag — the whole point of the probe is that those come from the catalog, one level at a time.

output.result: { validInput, reason, runKey, userLanguage, title, titles }

steps.doneAnchor: none (the root plants the tree directly)

steps.goal: Break the definition into REGIONS (each an interaction a molecule could serve) and name, for each, the group that covers it or null.
input: the definition, in the human prompt

checks: every region carries a need and a reason
gate.onFail: retry 1 with the errors in the prompt; a 2nd failure fails the step

steps.goal: Read c1's answer and plant one c2 step per DISTINCT group, plus c3 depending on all of them. With no group chosen it plants c3 alone — the honest empty report, which is what battery case #10 exercises.
For ONE group: choose the molecule for each region c1 assigned to it, plus which quick-reference scenario was used.
input: level 2 of the group (mod.skill of its index.defs.ts)
the regions of this group, in the human prompt

checks: THE ANTI-INVENTION CHECK: every tag belongs to mod.molecules[].tag of THIS group, spelled in full
a bare short name is refused with the full tag in the message
the group matches the step's group
every region belongs to this group's list, and none is left unanswered
scenarioUsed belongs to mod.scenarios[].scenario or is null
tag null is allowed with a reason
gate.onFail: retry 1 with the errors in the prompt; a 2nd failure records ok: false and completes

steps.goal: Aggregate the run: entry, both steps' outputs, prompt sizes per step (with the catalog block apart), gate verdicts and how many times the anti-invention gate fired. Write run.json and render the readable summary.

output.result: the summary, in the step trace

artifacts.l4/agentChooseMolecules/<runKey>/input.j: the definition as it arrived, the runKey, the language and the level-1 reference
artifacts.l4/agentChooseMolecules/<runKey>/c1-grou: the regions with their group (or null) and reason
artifacts.l4/agentChooseMolecules/<runKey>/c2-<gro: the choices of one group, with ok and the gate history
artifacts.l4/agentChooseMolecules/<runKey>/prompt-: the size of the prompt assembled on attempt NN, split into instructions / catalog / input
artifacts.l4/agentChooseMolecules/<runKey>/trace-<: the gate verdict of attempt NN
artifacts.l4/agentChooseMolecules/<runKey>/run.jso: the consolidated run — this is the file the battery is scored from

acceptance.battery: the 10 page definitions of the pilot control, one run each, scored by hand against its gabarito
acceptance.moleculeHitRate: a clear majority (c2), each miss analysed: the agent's fault or the catalog's?
acceptance.inventedTags: ZERO reaches an artifact. Every time the gate fires is recorded in run.json — the gate holding is not the same as the model getting it right.
acceptance.honesty: case #10 answers group: null on both regions, with no plausible neighbour invented
acceptance.tie: case #4 (combobox × autocomplete): if it misses consistently, the registered fallback is a contrastive sentence in the source # Objective of the tied molecules — never a new keywords field (decision of 2026-08-19)
acceptance.promptSize: level 1 ~387 estimated tokens and level 2 between 505 and 1452 per group, measured on the seeded files on 2026-08-19; the run confirms the assembled prompt stays in that order of magnitude

outOfScope: writing or fixing usage.ts / creation.ts (manual — decision of 2026-08-17; the defective examples are tracked by their own control, outside this project)
n7-index / i6-index / v4-index and the indexGroupPage skill — including inverting the scenarios table (§11.5)
the keywords field (decided against on 2026-08-19: risk of superficial vocabulary matching)
the local theme / 102054 (second round) and the 26 groups outside the pilot
writing the page: this probe chooses, it does not compose
planting: Two phases, for the reason agentImproveMolecule2 has a router: the branch is not known when the tree is planted. Phase 1 (root afterPromptStep) plants c1 and the fan-out step. Phase 2 (root beforePromptStep on c1r-fanout) reads c1's result and plants the c2 steps plus c3. c3 depends on the c2 anchors by NAME, all of which were planted in the same batch — never on a shared 'c2-done', which would be an anchor several steps write.
